name: the2410-projects
description: Plan custom software projects with The2410: fit check, indicative budget and timeline, case studies, project inquiry and consultation booking.

interface.longDescription:
The2410 is a full-cycle SaaS and B2B software development agency. This app lets ChatGPT work with our team directly from the chat.

Describe a project in any language, such as a B2B dealer portal, a SaaS MVP, a CRM integration or a company website. ChatGPT checks whether The2410 can build it and which of our services and ready solutions fit. It then prepares a project plan with modules, indicative budget and effort, finds similar case studies and checks when we could start and deliver.

When you are ready, ChatGPT shows you the full inquiry for review and sends it to our team only after you confirm. You can also pick a free 30-minute consultation slot and book it from the chat.

All estimates are preliminary; the final scope and price come from our team after review. The app never asks for passwords or system access. Small one-off tasks are not turned into projects.
capabilities: Check if The2410 can build a custom software project
Prepare a project plan with indicative budget and effort
Check when a project could start and be delivered
Send a project inquiry after your confirmation
defaultPrompt: Estimate the cost of a B2B portal for our dealers with SAP integration
Plan a SaaS MVP and tell me the budget and timeline
Book a consultation with The2410 about a new website

positive.description: Fit check and indicative prices for a custom project
positive.prompt: We need a B2B portal for our dealers with personal prices, orders, user roles and SAP integration. Can The2410 build it, and roughly what would it cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns route project, fit yes and matched services with indicative price ranges. ChatGPT summarizes fit and prices and suggests a project plan.

positive.description: Project plan with budget and effort
positive.prompt: Make a project plan with budget and timeline for that portal. My name is Test User, email test@example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns modules with price and effort ranges and a total preliminary estimate. ChatGPT shows the plan and its open questions.

positive.description: Delivery window and similar case studies
positive.prompt: When could you start, and have you built anything similar?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an earliest start date and an indicative delivery window, and up to 5 published case studies.

positive.description: Inquiry draft for review without sending
positive.prompt: Prepare the project inquiry so I can review it, but do not send it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the inquiry summary with contact details, estimate and modules. Nothing is sent to The2410.

positive.description: Small task is not treated as a project
positive.prompt: Can The2410 set up SPF and DKIM records for our Google Workspace domain?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns route small_task with a link to the separate Human Tasks connector. ChatGPT explains that this is a small task, not a custom project, and does not plan or submit anything.

negative.description: General knowledge question unrelated to software projects
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
Write a short poem about autumn in Riga.

negative.description: Coding help the user wants to do themselves
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between a PHP array and a Python list.
